title: Site presentation settings

story.need: manage shared identity, navigation, footer, metadata, social links, and redirects
story.outcome: the public site remains coherent without hard-coded presentation content

scope: Render the published site shell and metadata
Configure ordered navigation, social profiles, and redirects
dataRequirements: Settings revisions are immutable and numbered
Draft and published settings pointers are independent
Links use the shared safe-link policy
permissions: Only authenticated owners may change settings
Anonymous visitors receive only published settings

acceptanceCriteria.given: published settings and an authenticated owner
then: the settings draft contains the ordered changes
the public shell and metadata use the new revision
body and field text use regular weight
labels and controls use medium weight
